title: Tshiamiso mo gare ga Bagwebi
intro: Setshwantsho se ne se eme fa pele ga batho ba ba neng ba jewa ke kgogedi ya go bona dipoelo, se ba bitsa gore ba ikanyege le go dira dilo ka tshiamo mo ditirisanong tsa bone. Motlhanka yono wa ga Allah o ne a tlhagisa kgatlhanong le go naya selekanyo se sekhutshwane le go fetola sekale. Batho ba ne ba gana go reetsa, ba tshosetsa gore ba tla leleka motho yono mo lefatsheng la bone. Lefatshe ka bolone le ne le tla tsoga go ba atlhola. Ke mang yo o neng a emela tshiamiso mo bagwebing?
clues: Ke ne ka romelwa go nna morongwa kwa bathong ba ba neng ba tseneletse thata mo kgwebong le mo kgwebong.
Batho ba me ba ne ba ntsha selekanyo se sekhutshwane fa ba kala dithoto tsa ba bangwe.
Ba ne ba ntshosetsa gore ba tla nteleka mo lefatsheng leo fa nka ganelela mo go ba biletseng tumelo.
Ke gakologelwa ke le sebui se se botswerere go gaisa baporofeti.
Batho ba gaetsho ba ne ba tshwarwa ke thoromo e e maatla ya lefatshe e e neng ya ba tlogela ba se na botshelo mo magaeng a bone.
Ke ne ka romelwa kwa bathong ba Madyan kwa bokone jwa Hijaz.

arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰشُعَيْبُ أَصَلَوٰتُكَ تَأْمُرُكَ أَن نَّتْرُكَ مَا يَعْبُدُ ءَابَآؤُنَآ أَوْ أَن نَّفْعَلَ فِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِنَا مَا نَشَـٰٓؤُا۟ ۖ إِنَّكَ لَأَنتَ ٱلْحَلِيمُ ٱلرَّشِيدُ
verse: They said, "O Shuʿayb, does your prayer [i.e., religion] command you that we should leave what our fathers worship or not do with our wealth what we please? Indeed, you are the forbearing, the discerning!" (11:87)
